missing_value_policy: native LightGBM NaN handling; no imputation
custom_objective_dataset_label_policy: classification-only rows receive an inert finite Dataset-label placeholder; the custom objective retains the original NaN target mask, so these rows receive no regression supervision

hyperparameter_optimization.regression_objective: mean inner-fold MSE on measured-logBB rows; minimize
hyperparameter_optimization.classification_objective: mean inner-fold balanced accuracy on all rows; maximize
hyperparameter_optimization.pareto_selection: equal-weight Euclidean distance to the ideal point after min-max normalization across the Pareto front
